query:
select r.id as "id!", r.class as "class!", r.valid_from as "valid_from!"
        from records r
        join unnest($3::text[], $4::timestamptz[]) as horizon(class, cutoff)
          on horizon.class = r.class
        where r.tenant_id = $1
          and r.scope_id = $2
          and r.kind = 'derived'
          and r.valid_from <= horizon.cutoff
        order by r.valid_from, r.id
        limit $5
